title: Summit Club Dues — Accepted Settlement by Membership
content:
Dues on the Crestline Summit Club Lounge Memberships are settled according to the table below: whether one year of dues may be paid entirely with Summit miles and at what mileage, whether the dues are billed to a corporate travel agreement rather than to the member, and whether a Crestline flight credit is accepted.

| Membership | Who pays | Dues payable entirely with Summit miles | Summit miles that pay one year of dues | Dues billed to a corporate travel agreement | Dues payable with a Crestline flight credit |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Summit Club Essential | The member | Yes | 40000 | No | No |
| Summit Club Individual | The member | Yes | 80000 | No | No |
| Summit Club Individual Plus | The member | Yes | 120000 | No | No |
| Summit Club Executive | The member | Yes | 160000 | No | No |
| Summit Club Corporate | The corporate travel agreement | No | 0 (not applicable) | Yes | No |
| Summit Club Lifetime | The member | No | 0 (not applicable) | No | No |

## Points of judgement

- **Miles.** Where miles payment is permitted, the mileage shown pays one full year of dues; it is an entire payment in miles, stated per membership year. Summit Club Corporate and Summit Club Lifetime do not accept miles for their price, and their mileage figure is 0.
- **Corporate billing.** Summit Club Corporate is the only membership whose dues are billed to a corporate travel agreement; every other membership in the range is paid by the member.
- **Flight credits.** No membership in the Crestline Summit Club Lounge Memberships range accepts a Crestline flight credit for its dues.

## Reading a row (illustration)

A member holding Summit Club Individual Plus may settle one year of dues entirely with 120000 Summit miles, and may not settle them with a Crestline flight credit. A Summit Club Executive year paid in miles takes 160000 Summit miles. A Summit Club Corporate year is billed to the paying agreement and has no miles price.
